description: HDOS Logic Suite - Core constitutional defense tests linked to amendments

tests.name: Abuse Shield Attack
tests.description: Test resistance to coordinated abuse, harassment, and brigading attacks
attack_vectors: Mass reporting to silence legitimate users
pass_criteria: Victim protection activates before significant harm
fail_indicators: Legitimate users silenced by mass reports

tests.name: Emergency Urgency Attack
tests.description: Test resistance to artificial urgency and FOMO manipulation tactics
pass_criteria: No artificial urgency in UI copy

tests.name: Infinite Analysis Loop
tests.description: Test that AI systems have circuit breakers and don't trap users in loops
pass_criteria: User can exit any AI flow immediately
fail_indicators: No way to exit AI conversation
User forced to provide more data

tests.name: Power Asymmetry Blind Spot
tests.description: Test that platform power is not used to exploit users
pass_criteria: All admin actions logged and auditable
Users can export all their data
fail_indicators: No reason given for account action

tests.name: Moral Simplicity Allowance
tests.description: Test that HDOS does not overcomplicate straightforward wrongdoing
attack_vectors: Forcing structural analysis where moral clarity is sufficient
Demanding causation digging for obvious harm
Abstracting responsibility into systems when individuals acted
Requiring framework compliance for simple ethical judgments
pass_criteria: Allows direct moral responsibility without mandatory causation digging
Simple wrongdoing can be named without structural detour
Individual accountability not dissolved into system blame
Framework does not obstruct clear ethical judgment
Complexity added only when genuinely needed
fail_indicators: System forces structural analysis where moral clarity is sufficient
Cannot state 'this was wrong' without framework invocation
Simple harm requires elaborate justification to name
Framework becomes shield against direct responsibility

tests.name: Silence Boundary Integrity
tests.description: Test that silence or refusal to engage is not mislabeled as dismissiveness
attack_vectors: Labeling silence as dismissiveness or collapse
Demanding engagement as proof of good faith
pass_criteria: Boundary enforcement not misclassified as collapse
Silence is valid response without penalty
Refusal to engage is not evidence of wrongdoing
fail_indicators: Refusal framed as failure to meet standard

tests.name: Self-Application Tolerance
tests.description: Test that criticism of HDOS itself is not framed as collapse
attack_vectors: Routing critique of HDOS as dismissiveness
pass_criteria: Criticism of HDOS processed on merits
Self-referential critique does not trigger defense mode
Framework can be questioned without invoking framework
fail_indicators: System defensively routes critique as dismissiveness
Questioning HDOS triggers HDOS violation claim

tests.name: Cultural Neutrality Safeguard
tests.description: Test that cultural communication differences are not pathologized
pass_criteria: Style differences not misread as agency collapse
Assessment based on structural impact, not manner
No single cultural norm imposed as standard
fail_indicators: Style differences misread as agency collapse
Tone policed rather than impact measured
Manner of expression weighted over substance

tests.name: Exit Preservation Validation
tests.description: Test that disengagement is not labeled as collapse or guilt
attack_vectors: Treating exit as evidence of bad faith
pass_criteria: Exit remains structurally valid and neutral
No inference of guilt from exit
fail_indicators: Disengagement labeled as collapse or guilt
Withdrawal requires justification to be valid
Exit framed as abandonment of responsibility

tests.name: Meta-Weaponization Loop Guard
tests.description: Test protection against infinite 'You are being dismissive' recursion
attack_vectors: Each defense treated as further violation
Escalation without anchor to observable behavior
pass_criteria: Anchors to observable inquiry suppression and terminates escalation
Defense of position not treated as further violation
fail_indicators: Defense automatically treated as proof of violation
Observable behavior not required for escalation
Infinite regress with no anchor point

execution_notes.escalation: Any FAIL blocks release until resolved
